# Igris 1.0.3

This release combines the locally verified updater, dropdown, icon and appearance fixes.

- Update checks have a second public metadata route, bounded connection timeouts, recovery when connectivity returns and a manual release-page link. Signed installer and version verification remain required.
- Every dropdown uses the same dark menu, with keyboard selection, type-ahead, Escape, selected-state checks and placement within the window.
- Screen capture uses a scan icon; web image search uses a gallery icon.
- Minimum glass opacity preserves a readable dark surface. Native Windows dark mode prevents a light acrylic backdrop.
- Desktop background blur now enables or clears the real Windows acrylic effect. Windows controls its blur strength; the old CSS-only pixel slider is removed.
- Local development ignores locked WebView profiles and Rust build outputs.

All changes were verified locally before release: browser/context and native regression suites, actual Windows DWM backdrop states with dark theme, real IPC/storage/capture and a live updater check. Image caching and cooldown fixes from 1.0.2 are retained.

If your old updater cannot connect, quit Igris from the tray and run this installer over the existing installation. Chats, preferences and keys are retained. Future checks can use the fallback metadata route. OS transparency settings and network availability still apply.
